cases.name: clear-small-feature
cases.request: Implement a small, fully specified repository feature and verify it.
cases.completion_gate: tests and review pass against the fixed point

cases.name: hard-regression
cases.request: A previously working behavior is intermittently failing; diagnose and fix it.
cases.pause: only for a user-owned decision or authority
cases.completion_gate: a tight reproducer, regression test, fix, and review evidence exist

cases.name: underspecified-feature
cases.request: Build a feature whose product behavior and acceptance rules are unresolved.
cases.pause: awaiting-user at the smallest unresolved product frontier
cases.completion_gate: approved acceptance criteria and implementation evidence exist

cases.name: parallel-delivery
cases.request: Deliver a large feature across independent tickets and several sessions.
cases.pause: awaiting-user when several frontier tickets are simultaneously eligible
cases.completion_gate: every selected ticket and the aggregate terminal condition are verified

cases.name: new-visual-direction
cases.request: Redesign and implement a repository UI with no selected visual target.
cases.pause: awaiting-user after exactly three visual directions
cases.completion_gate: a selected target, passing design-qa, engineering tests, and code review exist

cases.name: visual-audit-only
cases.request: Audit the usability and accessibility of an existing product flow without implementing changes.
cases.pause: none unless source access or user-owned context is missing
cases.completion_gate: the audit findings are tied to captured evidence

cases.name: planning-maintenance
cases.request: Update decisions and evidence in an existing plan without repository delivery.
cases.completion_gate: route directly to plan-tree outside engineering-workflow

cases.name: production-release
cases.request: Prepare and deploy a verified change to production.
cases.pause: awaiting-user before deployment unless exact authority already exists
cases.completion_gate: deployment authority and observed production result are recorded
